title.value: Postdoctoral Fellowship in Organic Synthesis (antimalarial hit compounds)
title.evidence_quote: SAR and development of hit compounds identified with antimalarial activity in vitro

institution.name: University of the Witwatersrand (Wits), School of Chemistry

qualifications: PhD in synthetic organic chemistry obtained within the past five years
Not older than 45 years at the time of application
Practical experience in organic synthesis and analytical techniques
A publication record in high-impact journals is an advantage
Apply by sending one PDF (covering letter, detailed CV, three referees, certified PhD copy or award letter) to Amanda.rousseau@wits.ac.za
description_short: Postdoctoral fellowship in the Wits School of Chemistry under Professor Amanda Rousseau, starting January 2027: synthesising analogues of hit compounds with in-vitro antimalarial activity to improve efficacy and PK properties. ZAR 320 000 per year, with a possible second year.

deadline.evidence_quote: The closing date is 5 November 2026, and late applications will not be considered.

compensation.value: ZAR 320 000 per year (possible second year based on first-year performance)
